mapsmith.builder.started_chat: Building. Press G to pause, or /mapsmith stop.
mapsmith.builder.paused: Paused. Press G to carry on.
mapsmith.builder.no_plan: Nothing to build here: open a project in the studio (U) and press Place here first.
mapsmith.builder.too_far: The art is too far away: go to around %s, %s and press G again.
mapsmith.restock.none: Paused: out of %s, and none in my shulker boxes or the chests near the art. Get more and press G.
mapsmith.gather.none: Paused: out of %s, and I couldn't find any to mine near the art. Get more and press G.
mapsmith.gather.lost: Paused: I can't find my way back to the art. Walk back to it and press G.
mapsmith.restock.box: Getting blocks out of a shulker box
mapsmith.restock.box_back: Picking the shulker box back up
mapsmith.restock.going: Getting blocks from the chest at %s, %s, %s
mapsmith.builder.out_of: Paused: out of %s. Get more and press G.
mapsmith.builder.done: Finished! %s placed, %s broken. Stand in the middle of each map and use an empty map to make it.
mapsmith.builder.stuck: Paused: I can't get to the rest from here. Move closer and press G.
mapsmith.builder.unloaded: Paused: part of the art isn't loaded. Walk towards it and press G.
mapsmith.builder.waiting_walk: Walk on: nothing more to do in reach
mapsmith.hud.check: Map check: %s%% right · %s wrong · %s not loaded
mapsmith.hud.done: Builder: finished ✔ · make the map at %s, %s (this map's middle)
mapsmith.hud.map: This map: %s%% right · %s wrong · %s not drawn yet
mapsmith.hud.map_perfect: This map matches the art perfectly ✔
mapsmith.hud.map_blank: This map hasn't drawn the art yet: hold it in the middle of the map square
mapsmith.hud.map_other: This map doesn't cover the art (or is zoomed out)
mapsmith.no_project: No project open: press U to open the studio.
mapsmith.placed: Placed: from %s, %s, %s to %s, %s (y %s is the bottom), lined up with the map grid.
mapsmith.studio.open_picture.tip: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TGA. You can also drop a picture onto this window.
mapsmith.studio.pictures_folder.tip: Pictures put in this folder are listed here.
mapsmith.studio.drop_hint: Drop a picture onto this window, or open one, to make map art of it.
mapsmith.studio.not_picture: That isn't a picture Mapsmith can read.
mapsmith.studio.maps.tip: How many maps the art spans. Each map is 128×128 blocks.
mapsmith.studio.mode.flat.tip: Every block level: one shade of each colour. Easiest to build, and carpets work. Click for staircase.
mapsmith.studio.mode.staircase.tip: Blocks step up and down to get a light, normal and dark shade of every colour: three times the colours. Click for flat.
mapsmith.studio.max_height.tip: Keeps staircase art low, so it's quicker to build and easier to walk on, at some cost to the colours.
mapsmith.studio.dither.tip: Mixes colours in patterns so the eye sees colours in between. None gives flat areas of colour.
mapsmith.studio.strength.tip: Lower makes it smoother, with fewer speckles.
mapsmith.studio.fit.tip: Fill: crops to fill the maps (drag the preview to choose the part). Fit: all of it, with a border. Stretch: all of it, squashed to fit.
mapsmith.studio.resample.tip: Smooth for photos and drawings; sharp keeps pixel art's pixels crisp.
mapsmith.studio.zoom.tip: Crops in closer. Scroll on the preview to zoom, drag it to move.
mapsmith.studio.blocks.tip: Which block makes each colour, and which colours to use.
mapsmith.studio.reset.tip: Back to the defaults, keeping the size.
mapsmith.studio.show.tip: Switch between the art and the picture it's made from (or hold Space).
mapsmith.studio.place.tip: Puts the art's top-left (north-west) map on the map square you're standing in, with its bottom at your feet.
mapsmith.studio.build.tip: The builder places it for you (G starts and pauses it). Place it first.
mapsmith.studio.export.tip: Saves a Litematica (.litematic) and a WorldEdit (.schem) schematic in the schematics folder, and a PNG of what the maps will show.
mapsmith.studio.exported: Saved. The schematics' corner goes on the reference row's west end.
mapsmith.studio.projects.tip: Close this project and pick another.
mapsmith.settings.speed.tip: How fast the builder places blocks in survival. Servers with anti-cheat may want 10 or less.
mapsmith.settings.creative_speed.tip: How fast the builder places blocks in creative.
mapsmith.settings.rotate.tip: Turns to look at each block it places or breaks, as you would by hand. Some servers check.
mapsmith.settings.fix.tip: Breaks blocks of the wrong colour, and anything in the way, and puts the right ones in.
mapsmith.settings.walk.tip: Walks (or flies, in creative) from one part of the art to the next. Off: it builds what's in reach and you move.
mapsmith.settings.fly.tip: In creative, flies over the art instead of walking.
mapsmith.settings.ghosts.tip: Shows each block still to place as a see-through cube of its colour, and blocks to break outlined in red.
mapsmith.settings.range.tip: How far around you blocks to place are shown.
mapsmith.settings.grid.tip: Gold lines on map borders, faint ones on chunk borders, near your feet.
mapsmith.settings.hud.tip: How the art is coming along, what the builder's doing, and how a map you're holding compares.
mapsmith.palette.defaults.tip: The usual block for every colour.
mapsmith.palette.carried.tip: Uses only blocks in your inventory (and shulker boxes in it): the one you have most of for each colour.
mapsmith.palette.gatherable.tip: Uses only blocks the builder can get by itself: ones you carry, and ones it can mine near the art (more with a Silk Touch tool). Colours it can't get are left out.
mapsmith.palette.no_falling.tip: Swaps sand, gravel, concrete powder and carpets for blocks that stay put.
mapsmith.palette.carpets.tip: Flat art uses carpets where a colour has one: 2 wool make 3 carpets.
mapsmith.palette.filler.tip: What the hidden blocks are made of: supports under the art and the reference row north of it.
mapsmith.palette.cell.tip: %s blocks give this colour. Click: next block · Shift-click: back · Right-click: don't use this colour.
mapsmith.palette.needs_below: Needs a block under it (it's added).
mapsmith.materials.title: Materials for %s:
